definition.records: nine (phrase -> (slot, name)) rows; the key is the phrase, the value the entity

segment_a.key: sequence_key: the characters in order, multiplicity kept, no positions dropped
segment_a.read: a record answers only when its whole character sequence occurs contiguously in the query; exactly one containment answers, two or more say ambiguous_multiple_anchors, zero says no_match; an empty or undecodable query says no_match with reason empty_key

segment_b.write: the 9 synonymous paraphrases are appended as additional keys onto the segment-A table, each carrying the same (slot, name) value: one value, many keys
segment_b.alias_rule: an alias answers only under the same containment rule as segment A

definition.unknown_inputs: the 12 frozen candidates of R12, identical in both segments
definition.fragments: each written phrase cut at byte offset 1 and 2 (18 inputs, not valid UTF-8)
definition.sentences: the 20 describe sentences read whole, without localisation

criteria.segment_a: 12 unknown candidates answer 0; 18 byte fragments answer 0; 20 whole sentences mis-point 0 (a non-answer is not a mis-point); capability 40/40 with zero wrong pointers; nine closed-state checks identical before and after.
criteria.segment_b: the 9 aliases read back the same entity 9/9; every segment-A zero reading is still 0 after the alias write; key count and entity count reported, not gated.
criteria.reporting: the two segments are reported separately; segment A passing does not carry segment B.
